title: East Nashville Cozy Gem! Lots of Parking!
description:
This modern newly built East Nashville home (completed in 2022) is ideally located! Just an 8-minute drive takes you to the vibrant heart of Music City and the iconic Broadway strip. 8 minutes in the other direction is Opryland! Nestled in a quiet, trendy neighborhood, it’s perfect for families, business travelers, or weekend escapes.
Permit #:20220809088

The space
This residence offers three spacious bedrooms, each with its own private full bathroom. Additionally, a small office has been thoughtfully converted into a triple bunk room accommodating up to three adults (with a weight limit of 250 pounds per bunk). An upstairs common area also includes a full-size futon for additional sleeping space. A conveniently located half bath on the main level brings the total to four bedrooms and three and a half bathrooms.

The property provides on-site parking for up to five vehicles, depending on their size, ensuring ample parking space for guests.

Guest access
Keypad self entry

Other things to note
There are two large screen televisions. One is located in the main living room and the second one is upstairs in the common area/game room space.
